retainedHostedFields.fields: installation UUID; device name; token hash; created/last-seen/snapshot-received timestamps; latest snapshot
retainedHostedFields.content: Up to2000 library entries (source/manga IDs, title, optional author/completed/last-read page); up to100 source names/IDs/search support; current/last reading title/chapter IDs/title/number/volume, visible page range/total/active/update time; permission/capability/truncation flags
retainedHostedFields.retention: Latest snapshot replaced by later foreground sync. No age-based deletion. Deleted on successful connected disconnect.

retainedHostedFields.fields: job UUID/device ID/kind; query/source IDs/repository URL/book IDs/pagination/before filter; idempotency key; status/approval/execution claim; created/updated times; result/errors
retainedHostedFields.content: Catalog matches; library additions; requested saved reading-history pages (up to100 chapter records per job); installed-source/repository catalog results; approved source changes
retainedHostedFields.retention: Up to100 nonterminal jobs; up to2000 recent terminal jobs pruned on subsequent job creation. No age-based TTL. History-access off removes history jobs; library access off removes catalog/source-catalog jobs. Connected disconnect deletes device jobs.

retainedHostedFields.fields: One latest JPEG up to350KiB; manga/chapter/title/page metadata; capture time; image hash and page/session/generation IDs; up to24 annotations including label text/strokes; revision/pause state; closed-session UUIDs
retainedHostedFields.retention: Connection-mode page has no time expiry and stays while offline/backgrounded until superseded, revoked, permission removed, or connected disconnect. Legacy timed mode expires via Durable Object alarm. Revocation replaces content with bounded tombstone metadata; disconnect removes the coaching row.

retainedHostedFields.fields: installation UUID; identity/token/purchase hashes; disabled flag; active lease original transaction ID, purchase hash, Apple expiry/checked/lease-until times
retainedHostedFields.retention: Lease cleared on connected disconnect. Hashed installation/purchase bindings remain without fixed deletion schedule to protect ownership/device limits. Raw signed purchase JWS is verified in-flight, not stored in the lease.

retainedHostedFields.fields: client/family IDs; hashed access/refresh credentials; access and refresh expiry times; spent refresh hashes
retainedHostedFields.retention: 15-minute access, 30-day refresh logical validity; spent list bounded128. Expired entries filtered/pruned on subsequent operations, not guaranteed physically deleted at wall-clock expiry. Connected disconnect clears active grants.

retainedHostedFields.fields: client ID/name/exact callback URLs/auth method and optional secret hash; pending callback/state/PKCE challenge/browser hash/decision/workspace ID; one-use code hashes; hashed-purchase to up-to-five installation IDs
retainedHostedFields.retention: Client records valid30days; pending5minutes; codes1minute; expired OAuth records purged on next OAuth request. Purchase allocation records have no fixed deletion schedule. No raw client secret stored.

retainedHostedFields.fields: hashed network addresses/rate bucket keys, request counts, expiry timestamps
retainedHostedFields.retention: Short logical windows from1minute to1day depending bucket. Expired rate rows removed on later rate checks. Raw IP addresses are used in-flight, not stored by this application limiter. Platform logging is configured off.
